CITY OF SAN MARINO

  CITY COUNCIL AGENDA

Steve Talt, Mayor  www.CityofSanMarino.org
Steven W. Huang, DDS, Vice Mayor  (626) 300-0700 Phone

Tony Chou, Council Member  City Hall Council Chamber

Calvin Lo, Council Member  2200 Huntington Drive
Gretchen Shepherd Romey, Council Member  San Marino, CA 91108

Philippe Eskandar, City Manager

  ADJOURNED REGULAR MEETING OF THE
  SAN MARINO CITY COUNCIL
  FRIDAY, OCTOBER 27, 2023 AT 9:30 AM
  BARTH ROOM CROWELL PUBLIC LIBRARY
  1890 HUNTINGTON DRIVE
  SAN MARINO, CA 91108

The City of San Marino appreciates your attendance. Citizens’ interest provides the Council
with valuable information regarding issues of the community.

Regular meetings are held on the 2nd Wednesday of every month at 6:00 p.m. Typically,
adjourned meetings are held on the last Friday of every month at 8:30 a.m.

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who
requires a reasonable modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting
should contact the City Clerk via email at CityClerk@CityofSanMarino.org or by phone at
(626) 300-0705 prior to the meeting for assistance.

The public is welcome to attend the meeting in person or remotely via Zoom, however, the
meeting will proceed as normal even if there are technical difficulties with Zoom. The City
will do it’s best to resolve any technical issues as quickly as possible.

How to view or listen to the meeting from home:
  Visit www.CityofSanMarino.org/Zoom

How to offer public comment from home:
  Public comment will be accepted by email to CityClerk@CityofSanMarino.org until
  3:00 p.m. the day before the meeting, to be read by the City Clerk during public
  comment. Lengthy public comment may be summarized in the interest of time, and
  previously distributed public comment will be noted. Any comments received after

   3:00 p.m. will be included in the public comment record but will not be read at the
  meeting.

  Public comment will be accepted electronically via the zoom.us teleconference
  module during the meeting. Zoom comments will be taken after the in-person
  comments.

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

Council Member Chou, Council Member Lo, Council Member Shepherd Romey, Vice Mayor
Huang, and Mayor Talt

POSTING OF AGENDA

The agenda is posted 72 hours prior to each meeting at the following locations: City Hall,
2200 Huntington Drive, the Crowell Public Library, 1890 Huntington Drive, and the
Stoneman Building, 1560 Pasqualito Drive. The agenda is also posted on the City’s website:
http://www.cityofsanmarino.org.

PUBLIC COMMENTS

The City welcomes public input. Members of the public may address the City Council by
completing a public comment card and giving it to the City Clerk prior to the meeting. At
this time, the public may address the City Council on items that are not on the agenda.
Pursuant to state law, the City Council may not discuss or take action on issues not on the
meeting agenda (Government Code Section 54954.2). The Mayor reserves the right to
place limits on duration of comments. Staff may be asked to follow up on such items.

  PRESENTATION

 2023 SAN GABRIEL VALLEY COUNCIL OF GOVERNMENTS UPDATE

  PUBLIC HEARINGS

 1.  PUBLIC HEARING TO CONSIDER AN EXTENSION TO AN URGENCY
  INTERIM ORDINANCE ESTABLISHING A MORATORIUM ON THE
  INSTALLATION OF ARTIFICAL TURF AND SYNTHETIC GRASS
  PURSUANT TO CALIFORNIA CODE SECTION 65858

AGENDA – OCTOBER 27, 2023  PAGE 2 of 5
   Recommendation: Staff recommends the City Council conduct a public hearing and
  then adopt Urgency Ordinance No. O-23-1410-U, by a four-fifths vote, extending the
  existing moratorium. If the City Council concurs with staff’s recommendation, an
  appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to adopt Urgency Ordinance No. O-23-1410-U, an Urgency Interim
  Ordinance of the City Council of San Marino Extending the Term of Ordinance No. O-
  21-1385-U, Establishing a Temporary Moratorium on the Installation of Artificial Turf
  and Synthetic Grass in the City of San Marino.”

  NEW BUSINESS

 2.  APPROVAL OF RESOLUTION R-23-28 ADOPTING THE COMMUNITY
  CALENDAR APPROVAL POLICY

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Council approve Resolution R-23-28 and
  adopt the Community Calendar Approval Policy. If the City Council concurs with
  staff’s recommendation, an appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to approve Resolution R-23-28 and adopt the Community Calendar Approval
  Policy.”
 3.  APPROVAL OF RESOLUTION R-23-27 ADOPTING THE LACY PARK
  CLOSURE FOR MAJOR EVENTS POLICY

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Council approve the Lacy Park Closure for
  Major Events Policy. If the City Council concurs with staff’s recommendation, an
  appropriate motion would be:

  ”I move to approve Resolution R-23-27 adopting the Lacy Park Closure for Major
  Events Policy.”

 4.  ADOPTION OF REVISIONS TO THE CITY STREET TREE POLICY AND
  PROCEDURES AMENDING THE REMOVAL PROCESS

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Council adopt the recommended revisions
  to the City’s Street Tree Policy and Procedures. If the City Council concurs, an
  appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to adopt the recommended revisions to the City’s Street Tree Policy and
  Procedures”

 5.  SAN MARINO COMMUNITY CENTER FACILITY  USE  FEES  FOR
  COMMUNITY & NOT-FOR-PROFIT GROUPS

  Recommendation: Staff requests that the City Council provide direction regarding the
  Group A user fees for the San Marino Community Center.

  Should the City Council wish to set the Group A user fees for the San Marino
  Community Center based on a cost of service model as presented in Attachment 1,

AGENDA – OCTOBER 27, 2023  PAGE 3 of 5
   an appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to adopt Resolution No. R-23-29 amending Resolution No. R-21-10 to
  include revised Section 12 of the Community Services Department’s Schedule of Fees
  for Service for FY 2023-24.”

  CONSENT CALENDAR

 6.  APPROVAL OF REQUEST TO CLOSE THE LIBRARY ON MARCH 15-16,
  2024 AND WAIVE APPLICABLE FEES FOR SAN MARINO PUBLIC
  LIBRARY  FOUNDATION’S  FUNDRAISER  EVENT,  DELICIOUS
  DESTINATIONS

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Council approve the closure of the Library
  on March 15-16, 2024, and waive applicable fees, for the purpose of holding the San
  Marino Public Library Foundation’s Delicious Destinations event. If the City Council
  concurs with staff’s recommendation, an appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to approve the closure of the Crowell Public Library on March 15-16, 2024,
  and waive applicable fees, for the purpose of holding the San Marino Public Library
  Foundation’s Delicious Destinations event.”

 7.  APPROVAL OF NOTICE OF COMPLETION FOR YEAR 1 OF THE ANNUAL
  SIDEWALK REPLACEMENT PROGRAM PROJECT NO. 22-9272

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the City Council accept Year 1 of the Multi-Year
  Sidewalk Replacement Program as complete and authorize the City Clerk to file the
  Notice of Completion. If the City Council concurs, an appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to accept Year 1 of the Multi-Year Sidewalk Replacement Program Project
  No. 22-9272 performed by CJ Concrete Construction, Inc., as complete, and
  authorize the City Clerk to file the Notice of Completion.”

 8.  ADOPTION OF ORDINANCE NO. O-23-1407 (SECOND READING)
  AMENDING MUNICIPAL CODE SECTIONS 23.02.14 AND 23.15.04.1 TO
  ALLOW MINISTERIAL APPROVAL WHEN RECONFIGURING SPACE
  WITHIN AN EXISTING DWELLING UNIT IN THE SINGLE-FAMILY (R-1)
  ZONE TO CREATE NO MORE THAN TWO ADDITIONAL BEDROOMS

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Council adopt Ordinance No. O-23-1407. If
  the City Council concurs with staff’s recommendation an appropriate motion would
  be:

  “I move to adopt Ordinance No. O-23-1407, an Ordinance of the San Marino City
  Council amending San Marino Municipal Code Sections 23.02.14 and 23.15.04.01 to
  implement Assembly Bill 916 by allowing ministerial approval when reconfiguring
  space within an existing residential dwelling unit in the single-family (R-1) zone to
  create no more than two additional bedrooms.”

 WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS OR PUBLIC WRITINGS DISTRIBUTION

This is an opportunity to announce any written communications pertaining to the City
received by members of the City Council. All public writings distributed by the City of San
Marino to at least a majority of the City Council regarding any item on this agenda will be
made available at the Public Counter at City Hall located at 2200 Huntington Drive, San
Marino, California 91108, and will also be included in the public agenda packet that will
available for review at the City Council meeting.
